explain_task.question: Using the revised model only, explain why the objective drops from -700.0 in the original run to -850.0 in the revised run, and identify the exact new code elements that force this change. Your answer must trace the month-2 inventory carry from the solver solution (`stock_2 = 1500`, `sell_3 = 1500`) back to the business rule and the exact `general_parameters.csv` field that causes it, and also interpret at least two dual/slack pairs from `Grain_Trading_TwoChannel_Credit.solution.json`—one binding and one nonbinding—using the exact constraint names and variable names from code/formulation (for example `min_inventory_2`, `warehouse_1`, `buy_fast[m]`, `credit_used[m]`). Finally, explain the business meaning of the shadow price on the binding inventory-related constraint and why you cannot linearly extrapolate that marginal value for a large RHS change once the active basis would switch.
